EXECUTABLE WORKFLOW 6A RECEIPT — SAVE AND VERIFY WITH THE CANONICAL CODEC

Source identity: exact exported main e584ad6d8a1b6bc5cb28ac1c406a239114f1f48a; grakern exact export 0329c43c88a0b71e9aa4456723bb16bac2fa3841. Scratch source was formatted and compiled from fixtures main; SHA-256 0308e1495510a5e1846f33193cd6906f7ac740c369e579a1d0b52b278f538e5b.

Complete public program:

package docsprobe

import storymodel4s.codec.StoryModelCodec
import storymodel4s.fixtures.wog.WarOfTheGhostsModel
import storymodel4s.story.{StoryModel, StoryValidator, ValidationPolicy}

object SaveAndVerify:
  def main(args: Array[String]): Unit =
    val model = WarOfTheGhostsModel.model
    val canonical = StoryModelCodec.encode(model)
    val checksum = StoryModelCodec.contentChecksum(model)
    val decoded = StoryModelCodec.decode(canonical).fold(e => sys.error(e.message), identity)
    val canonicalAgain = StoryModelCodec.encode(decoded)
    val revalidated = StoryValidator.validate(decoded, ValidationPolicy.default).validated

    println(s"canonical JSON characters: ${canonical.length}")
    println(s"content checksum: ${checksum.hex}")
    println("decode status: Draft")
    println(s"canonical fixed point: ${canonicalAgain == canonical}")
    println(s"revalidation: ${if revalidated.isDefined then "Validated" else "failed"}")
    println(
      s"revalidated checksum matches: ${revalidated.exists(StoryModelCodec.contentChecksum(_) == checksum)}"
    )
    println(
      s"phantom status changes bytes: ${StoryModelCodec.encode(StoryModel.adjudicated(model)) != canonical}"
    )

    val tampered = canonical.replace(
      s"\"schemaVersion\":\"${model.schemaVersion}\"",
      "\"schemaVersion\":\"2.0.0\""
    )
    StoryModelCodec.decode(tampered) match
      case Left(error) => println(s"tampered schema: rejected (${error.message})")
      case Right(_)    => println("tampered schema: ACCEPTED — unexpected")

Exact invocation used:
env COURSIER_CACHE=/private/tmp/storymodel4s-docs-model.US1jnV/cache STORYMODEL4S_GRAKERN_BUILD=/private/tmp/storymodel4s-docs-model.US1jnV/grakern sbt -batch -Dsbt.supershell=false -Dsbt.boot.directory=/private/tmp/storymodel4s-docs-model.US1jnV/sbt-boot -Dsbt.global.base=/private/tmp/storymodel4s-docs-model.US1jnV/sbt-global -Dsbt.ivy.home=/private/tmp/storymodel4s-docs-model.US1jnV/ivy "fixturesJVM/runMain docsprobe.SaveAndVerify"

Exact program output:
canonical JSON characters: 430246
content checksum: 481888370ce2c9d0ace956c25131cb132f5efcb5ff3205aaf40317d3aea08cb1
decode status: Draft
canonical fixed point: true
revalidation: Validated
revalidated checksum matches: true
phantom status changes bytes: false
tampered schema: rejected (decode at $: unsupported schema version 2.0.0 (supported: 0.1.0))

Program exit 0. Exact eight-line output SHA-256 00104511c62fe94e8897282eae36f4967e3077a30f0b016636e57201f3b6671d. scalafmtCheckAll ran separately after execution, exit 0. Focused behavioral courts at the same export: StoryModelCodecSuite 12/12 and WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite 2/2, both exit 0. Environment caveat: Homebrew Java 25.0.1; archive builds emit expected git-metadata warnings because the exact export has no .git directory.

Interpretation for the guide: StoryModelCodec is the canonical JSON contract, not a parallel docs schema. Encoding is a fixed point and the checksum binds those canonical content bytes. Decode intentionally yields StoryModel[Draft]; consumers must run StoryValidator before using APIs that require Validated. Revalidation restores the proof state and preserves the content checksum. Draft/Validated/Adjudicated are phantom evidence states, deliberately absent from the bytes, so “phantom status changes bytes: false” is correct and the checksum must never be presented as proof that validation or adjudication occurred. An unsupported schema fails before construction.

Limits to state: 430,246 is this WOG fixture’s canonical character count, not a promised size. Vectors remain sidecars; their manifests are inline. A syntactically decodable model can still fail StoryValidator, so decode success is not scientific validity. This closes only the canonical-model half of SAVE AND DELIVER. The self-contained CodexHtml result bundle remains bd-01M199WBM2YVZ3GVC2GA61TYCJ work and must preserve separate semantic/report/profile/delivery outcomes; do not fake it with hand-written JSON or claim it shipped.
